ambiguities: Each continuous object is a seven-unit-cube bent bar with coplanar unit seams omitted, exactly as in the source; dashed lines are its real hidden crease/outline edges, not an invented unit grid. Seven-cell occupancy is a native construction scale, not a displayed numerical condition. Panel Y is rigidly tilted rather than flattened to an upright silhouette. Source per-face lighting on the gray reference is standardized to uniform gray while option objects remain unfilled.
